blaster.notes: CityWalker hold LMB → BlasterBoltVfx stream; blaster_speed_mps=30, blaster_interval_sec=0.25, energy_cost_blaster=1; DamageSource.PLAYER_BLASTER=18. Aim reach follows laser aim (100m). Player: continuous fire while held (burst_count=1 per tick, fire_interval_s=0.25, cooldown_s=0). Monsters: 3-bolt burst then recover (monster_*).

charged_blast.notes: CityWalker Alt+LMB charge → ChargedBlastVfx; charged_blast_speed_mps=10, charge_sec=1.6, radius_max 2.52×scale, cooldown_sec=0.55, energy_cost_blast=20; DamageSource.PLAYER_BLAST=150. Aim uses same cursor ray as laser (100m). radius_m is max-charge sphere at 1×. Monsters keep full charge windup + long recovery (monster_cooldown_s); shorter AI throw reach (monster_range_m).

eye_laser.notes: CityWalker Ctrl+LMB → EyeLaserVfx; laser_speed_mps=60, laser_cooldown_sec=0.45, laser_range_m=100, energy_cost_laser=1; DamageSource.PLAYER_LASER=18. Player energy-gated. Monsters: telegraph + longer recovery + shorter engagement (monster_*). PLAYER_LASER still targets CREATURE — wire MONSTER_* when AI fires at the player.

fist.notes: Player punch/kick (CityWalker melee_reach_m=1.05). DamageSource.PLAYER_MELEE=34. No energy; no cooldown export — animation length gates the next strike. Distinct from monster contact `melee` (damage truly diverges).

melee.notes: Basic monster contact/swing. DamageSource.MONSTER_MELEE (player) / MONSTER_MELEE_MOB (creature). Clip binding later: prefer Rogue 1H_Melee_Attack_* then CreatureClips MELEE fallback. Not the player fist (see `fist`).

orb_convert.notes: Live mage convert orb (UndeadUnit CAST_COOLDOWN_SEC=20, ORB_RANGE_M=30; UndeadOrbProjectile SPEED_MPS=25, CAPTURE_RADIUS_M=1.76). DamageSource.UNDEAD_ORB=25 — four hits empty the player's 100 HP pool. Monster-only; energy_cost=0.

stomp.notes: CityWalker Q → feet-centered crater; radius = charged_blast_radius_max_m×scale (2.52 at 1×), stomp_cooldown_sec=0.85, energy_cost_stomp=10, stomp_impact_ratio=0.48; DamageSource.PLAYER_STOMP=110. Player windup is anim-ratio (not seconds). Monsters: ~0.4s foot telegraph + 6s recovery.

ambient.intent: Non-combat presence — no attacks, so nothing to hunt with.

chase.intent: Close and pursue. Hostility is faction-only: anything not of this body's faction, player and pedestrians included.

guard.intent: Hold a post on a short leash, then engage whatever other-faction body walked into it.

skirmish.intent: Standoff / ranged pressure. Attack pool is the full caster/artillery set; AI selection among them is deferred.

wander_hunt.intent: Roam until something of another faction is in aggro range, then chase it.

brute.intent: Tanky melee pressure — Quaternius Big / warrior bulk that sticks to whatever it committed to.

minion.intent: Convert fodder and pack hunters — fast, fragile, roam wide. chase + wander_hunt: close on any other-faction body in aggro range.

boss.intent: Grown-giant / elite path — high threat, city-wide aggro range, chase melee.

ranged_boss.intent: Artillery elite — skirmish behaviour may use charged_blast / eye_laser (and the rest of the skirmish pool); AI selection deferred. Stack with boss when a body should be both giant and artillery (scalars take max).

melee_boss.intent: Melee elite — closes via chase; specialty template attack stomp (crater) plus contact melee from chase. Same hp_mult/damage_mult as ranged_boss.

rangestriker.intent: Standoff caster/skirmisher — skirmish attack pool (orb/blaster/eye_laser/charged_blast) plus chase melee when closing.

demolisher.intent: Relentless bruiser — wide aggro and a long leash, so once it commits it follows across a district. Stacks onto other templates to make a body harder to shake.

guard.intent: Dungeon holder — short leash, holds a post, engages whatever other-faction body reaches it.

monsters.notes: Live wave caster body; also eligible for BRUTE slot. Kit from behaviours: rangestriker/skirmish (blaster|eye_laser) + chase melee, plus the orb_convert specialty. Leans full ranged roster.
Reference-height fodder body the capsule numbers were measured on.

Caster-slot hybrid: hard-replaces behaviour-derived attacks to drop blaster/charged_blast (rapid/nuke feel wrong on a sword skirmisher) but keeps orb_convert, adds melee + eye_laser single-shot poke. Closer preferred_range; orb scalars stay intact (single template).
FODDER+BRUTE slots — max-scalar pack hunter / tank (hp/damage from brute).
Dungeon stomper — melee_boss + guard (scalars max: hp/damage 2.0/2.2, leash max(70,22)=70). Kit: stomp + melee.
Artillery demon — charged_blast sphere nuke + eye_laser; not the grown-giant boss path.
Hill cave caged boss — Unique; crumble aura + charged blast.
Giant + artillery stack: scalars take max (hp_mult 2.5, damage_mult 2.2); attacks union debris|melee|charged_blast|eye_laser. Magical elite silhouette.
Melee elite — stomp crater + contact melee; not grown-giant boss path.
Tanky stomper — melee_boss+brute (damage_mult max 2.2); body hp_mult 2.7 replaces merged max(2.0,1.4).
Cheapest pack silhouette in the blob family.
Tall spikes — hybrid fodder/tank; height decoration still goes through CreatureHealth's blob sqrt.
Promoted from rangestriker convert kit to ranged_boss artillery — charged_blast + eye_laser (no orb_convert).
Catalog note: rest pose sits 0.23 units below y=0 — vendored, not spawnable until fixed.
Flying rig — no ground locomotion; table row only.
Fantasy flyer: elite + ranged; not spawnable until flight exists.
Authored hovering ~1.57 units up — ambient table only.

cottage.hint: Walk-in plaster house with a clay roof

hot_tub.hint: Round stone tub with warm water

charged_blast.hint: Hold Alt fire, release to throw

minion.hint: Summon a half-strength ally (replaces the previous)

shield.hint: Toggle — drains energy while up and blunts hits

use_trap.hint: Aim at a world voxel and lob a hold trap there

crumble_stride.notes: While walking, destructible voxels ahead crumble with cascades. Skips cave-cage materials.
